scope: Theorem 8.1 (CWX tensor embedding) of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be simple, unitary and strongly rational. The Hilbert completion and the local actions of Theorem 5.3 define a fully faithful ∗-functor FV CWX : Repu (V ) −→ Rep(AV ). It has a unitary tensor structure identifying the Huang–Lepowsky fusion and braiding with Connes fusion and DHR braiding, respectively. In particular every object in its image is dualizable, hence has finite index.
